set.body:
From review of fx-render-capture (b81eb83). Both CI lanes run at output scale 1 (Linux xvfb, 1024x768 macOS runner), so HiDPI canvas sizing (k = ceil(outputScale) > 1) is never exercised in CI; the texture assertion at CanvasPlotHostFxSuite.scala:191 checks arithmetic only.

Acceptance: a studio.yml lane (generated from build.sbt) runs the FX suites at scale 2 (e.g. -Dglass.gtk.uiScale=2 under xvfb), and at least one test asserts sharpness from a snapshot (a one-device-pixel line stays one pixel wide) rather than arithmetic.
set.title: Studio CI: exercise HiDPI (output scale 2) FX rendering
